name: Aholah
overview: The name Aholah, meaning "His tent" or "tabernacle," is used in Ezekiel 23 to personify Samaria as an imaginary woman who embodies idolatry and unfaithfulness to God. Scripture depicts Aholah as playing the harlot, doting on her lovers such as the Assyrians, which symbolizes Israel's spiritual adultery. God commands judgment against Aholah for her abominations, highlighting the seriousness of idolatry and covenant unfaithfulness. The vivid imagery of Aholah as a lewd woman serves as a sobering warning against turning away from the Lord in pursuit of false alliances and idols.
